about: What the site reads from the Cloudflare R2 bucket (docs/r2.md): each prefix in the bucket and the folder under the data directory (data/private) it is uploaded from. `python3 -m cosh.r2 publish` syncs them all; the pages build their URLs from this file, and on localhost Vite serves the local folders under r2/ instead (web/vite.config.ts). A format change the published page can't read goes to a new prefix (people/v3 ...), uploaded before the page that reads it is deployed.
